spans.s: 1. रुध् (cf. √ 1. रुह्, of which this seems to be only another form) cl. 1. P. रो॑धति, to sprout, shoot, grow (only रो॑धति, RV. viii, 43, 6; and विरो॑धत्, i, 67, 9; accord. to some also p. रुधत्, i, 179, 4, in नद॑स्य रुधतः॑ का॑मः, ‘the desire of the growing reed’ i.e. of the membrum virile; others, ‘of the husband who keeps me away’, fr. √ 2. रुध्; cf. also नद).
3. रुध् (ifc.) impeding, holding (see कर-र्˚).
4. रुध् prob. a root of this form once existed with a meaning ‘to be red’.
(ifc.) id. (see अ॑-गो-र्˚).
N. of an Asura conquered by Indra, RV. (cf. दधि-क्रा).
(prob. fr. the above lost root रुध्, ‘to be red’; cf. रोहित and also under रुद्र) red, blood-red, bloody, AV. v, 29, 10
the blood-red planet or Mars, VarBṛS.; Pañcat.
a kind of precious stone (cf. रुधिराख्य)
(रु॑˚), n. (ifc. f(आ). ) blood, ŚBr. &c. &c.
saffron, Car.
N. of a city, Hariv. (cf. शोनित-पुर).
[cf. Gk. ἐρυθρός, ἔρευθος; Lat. ruber, rubeo, rufus; Lith. rùdas, raúdas, raudónas; Slav. rǔdrǔ, rǔděti; Goth. rauths; Angl.Sax. reád; Eng. red; Germ. rôt, rot.]
